services.name: CJ Reef Snorkeling Getaway
services.desc: The best getaway trip! 4 hours About If you love an adventure then look no further as Sunset Ski & Water sports will transport you to one of the most amazing reefs & private island beaches In SWFL. Your 4 hour adventure will have you relaxing on an isolated island accessible only by water. When on this amazing island beach you will not only have access to amazing snorkeling, you will find yourself amidst some of the best shelling in the world. CJ REEF, a Florida hidden gem is certain to leave you speechless. So book your adventure The best getaway trip! • Guided Boat Trip

services.name: Dolphin Boat Cruise
services.desc: This two hour cruise is certain to leave you speechless! 2 Hours About We'll tour the island around Sanibel, Fort Myers Beach while you feel the kiss of the SW Florida sun and the breeze upon your face. Chances are we'll see Turtles, Dolphins, Manatees, and maybe even an Eagle Ray. This trip is perfect for those of us that love life on the water and want to relax and let the sun melt our cares away. Please Note There is a minimum of 2 people required on this boat This two hour cruise is certain to leave you speechless!

services.name: Canal Boat Cruise
services.desc: Some might call this a booze cruise but we call this another relaxing day in paradise! 2 Hours About We'll begin our journey in Fort Myers and our first stop will be to get drinks at a really spectacular tropical bar, from there we'll head into the canals with your favorite beverages while enjoying the calmest waters, mangroves, million dollar homes and 1/4 to multi million dollar boats. When it comes to relaxing and letting go, we got you All Ages • 2 Hours • Up to 6 People

services.name: Fort Myers Beach Sunset Tour
services.desc: Join Capt. J as we set sail for calm waters and colorful skies! 1.5 Hours About Let me guide you and your family or friends around various island while we experience a picturesque SWFL sunset. This cruise will surely take your breath Ages 6+ • 1.5 Hours • Up to 6 People

services.name: Neon Nights Cruise
services.desc: This is an excellent way to escape for the evening. Your choice of music, RGB lighting throughout the boat, bring your own drinks and let Capt. J do the driving. I can't think of a better way to spend time out on the Experience the waters in SWFL at night with Capt. J

services.name: 4 Hour Guided Fishing Charter
services.desc: Welcome to SWFL where the fish are abundant! 4 Hours About Welcome to SWFL where the fish are abundant and there are more than 50 species caught annually. We target the offshore waters near Sanibel where you'll encounter snapper, grouper, redfish, sheeps head, and a variety of many other extremely tasty fish. What to Bring Hat Sunscreen Sunglasses Possibly a long sleeve Welcome to SWFL where the fish are abundant!
